The '''Heroes of Cularin''' was the name given to the large and disparate group of citizens of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] who were active in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] between [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] in defending the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. These individuals, often from humble origins, worked together to uncover untoward activities of the [[Metatheran Cartel]], the depredations of the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]], and other threats to the peace and safety of Cularin.
